German Accusative Prepositions: A2 Exercises

Choose accusative articles after für, ohne, gegen and durch. Practise complete noun phrases rather than isolated case labels.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the rule

Durch, für, gegen, ohne and um normally govern the accusative. The noun phrase after the preposition is not necessarily a direct object of the verb: Das Geschenk ist für einen Freund. Masculine definite der becomes den; feminine die and neuter das keep their forms.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not use the dative just because the noun describes a person receiving something. Für einen Freund takes accusative because of für.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice the form that changes and the role it plays in each sentence.

Worked example 1Wir laufen durch den Park am Fluss.We walk through the park by the river.
Worked example 2Das Paket ist für meine Nachbarin.The parcel is for my neighbour.
Worked example 3Ohne einen Plan wird es schwierig.It will be difficult without a plan.
Worked example 4Der Ball rollt gegen das Tor.The ball rolls against the gate.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Use the accusative definite article for each noun in brackets. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Das Geschenk ist für ___ Trainer. (der)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: den

Für takes accusative; masculine der becomes den.

Question 2. Sie geht ohne ___ Jacke hinaus. (die)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: die

Feminine accusative keeps die.

Question 3. Der Weg führt durch ___ Wald. (der)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: den

Durch requires accusative, so use den Wald.

Question 4. Wir spielen gegen ___ Team aus Bonn. (das)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: das

Neuter accusative keeps das.

Use it in your own sentence

Say you are walking through a park without your brother.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich gehe ohne meinen Bruder durch den Park.

Check your wording: Ohne and durch take accusative in these phrases.

What to practise next

Change the subject or noun in one model sentence. Check the verb form, case and word order before comparing it with the rule.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
